title: Personal Credit Cards: Counting the Points a Card Still Holds for a Restoring Deposit
content:
For a Personal Credit Cards deposit that restores an overdrawn autopay account, the number of points the card still holds is established from the card's own activity record at the time of handling.

## Count

The points still available on the card are every point the card has ever collected on purchases, less every point already spent through earlier redemptions, less every point taken off the card, whether through forfeiture or after a merchant refund. The count comes from the entries on the card's ledger as they stand when the matter is handled.

## Worked example (hypothetical entries)

| Entries on the card | Points |
|---|---|
| Collected on purchases, all entries together | 14620 |
| Spent through earlier redemptions | 5000 |
| Taken off after merchant refunds | 380 |
| Still held at handling time | 9240 |

The figure is a whole number of points, since every entry is in whole points.
